biotools.summary: Cybergenic is an open cancer genomics database and analysis resource. It reports how often driver mutations, gene fusions and copy-number amplifications and deletions occur in each tumour type, and which genes are co-mutated (co-occurrence) or mutually exclusive across public tumour cohorts: 196,184 mutation-burden-aware tests of 63,279 gene pairs from 24 cBioPortal studies, with false discovery correction. Its pages cover genes, single mutations and mutation classes, gene pairs, tumour types, fusions, copy-number changes and 2,062 cancer cell lines, each built from cited sources. Every test and frequency table downloads as open data with DOIs, and predictions are locked in a public hash-chained registry before they are tested. For research, not clinical decisions.
